scope: RB-B native Blender capture and preparation, excluding mutations, transport, rendering and model

raw_benchmark.timing_boundary: Each step starts after the Blender input writes and includes context.evaluated_depsgraph_get(), both captures and returned descriptors.
raw_benchmark.p95: Linear percentile over the pooled complete sequence times.
raw_benchmark.copy_count_boundary: Observable NumPy writes and temporary mesh calls; Blender internal copies and allocation sizes are unknown. Python metadata heap sizes are unmeasured.

review_decision: PASS: RB-B within frozen scope; RB-A plus RB-B permit BC implementation.
